Karnataka HC Stays Government Order on Withdrawal of Criminal Cases

The Karnataka High Court has stayed a government order directing the withdrawal of 52 criminal cases. The court's decision comes amid controversy over the government's move to drop charges against certain officials. The government had ordered the withdrawal of these cases, but the court has put its implementation on hold. This development has sparked debate about the government's handling of criminal cases and the role of the judiciary in such matters.
